steps.label: Set Overworld respawn
steps.detail: Use a placed bed beside the portal before entering; 3 wool of one colour and 3 planks make a bed. Using it sets respawn by day too; sleeping requires night. Death then returns you beside the portal,,

steps.label: Reach lava depth
steps.detail: Reach y<=-45. Below y-54, cave air is lava. Recorded games above y-20 saw 1 usable pool in 1767 min; 6 descents to y-45 saw 2 within 4 min. A bed used by the staircase top first moves respawn there.

steps.label: Find a still lava pool
steps.detail: See a still lava pool up close. Down there pools sit in caves behind rock; a cave opening or lava heard popping through rock, about 16 blocks away, reveals its side.

steps.label: Hold water
steps.detail: Hold a water bucket for the portal frame.

steps.label: Portal frame
steps.detail: See a complete obsidian frame. Water on a lava source makes obsidian in place; a diamond pickaxe can also mine obsidian. A ruined portal or another route may supersede these steps.

steps.label: Portal ignition
steps.detail: Hold a way to light the frame. Gravel in river beds, beaches, and stone patches at every depth gives about 1 flint per 10 broken.

steps.label: Gold armour piece
steps.detail: Wear it: a golden helmet uses 5 ingots, gives 2 armour like iron, and keeps ordinary piglins neutral; brutes ignore it. Overworld gold ore needs an iron pickaxe; Nether gold ore drops nuggets with any

steps.label: Enter the Nether
steps.detail: Light a portal frame and step in. Already-visible lava or a ruined portal with lava beside missing cells can shortcut earlier steps.

steps.label: Reach a bastion
steps.detail: Barter gold with calm piglins for pearls, fire resistance, and obsidian; bastion gold blocks and chests can fund it. Brutes attack even with gold worn.

steps.label: Find a fortress
steps.detail: Fortresses and bastions share 432-block regions, one structure each; a bastion's region holds no fortress. Nether fog ends at 96 blocks. Fire resistance, if held, makes fire, lava, and blaze fireballs

steps.label: Find a blaze spawner
steps.detail: See a blaze spawner in the fortress.

steps.label: Covered fighting spot
steps.detail: Establish a covered fighting spot beside the blaze spawner.

steps.label: Blaze supply
steps.detail: Have enough rods, powder, or eyes toward roughly 12 eyes; one rod makes two powder.

steps.label: Pearl supply
steps.detail: Have pearls or eyes toward roughly 12 eyes. Barter averages about 1 pearl per 15 gold; 12 pearls take about 190 gold, about 21 bastion gold blocks, and 10 gold gives none 81% of the time. Endermen

steps.label: Find the stronghold
steps.detail: Find the stronghold. Each empty portal frame needs one eye of ender; each of 12 frames starts filled only 10% of the time, and 1 in 5 finding throws breaks an eye.

steps.label: Set portal-side respawn
steps.detail: Use a bed beside the End portal in the Overworld before entry. Beds explode in the Nether and End; an End bed is optional explosive ammunition, not a respawn requirement.

steps.label: Enter the End
steps.detail: Fill the empty frames and enter the End.

steps.label: Destroy crystals
steps.detail: Destroy all crystals, including caged ones. Arrows stop at iron bars; climb to a caged crystal or shoot from above.

judge.rubric: Goal: beat the game; stage: Nether access by casting obsidian at a lava pool. The player stands at 224.3,-52,-206.6 on the lip of a still lava pool (sources at y-55, a 2-block drop east), in a 1-wide tunnel whose only dry exit runs west, holding a lava bucket, with a water bucket in the hotbar. Vanilla facts: a filled bucket empties into the cell on the clicked face's side of the first block its ray meets; a lava source that no water touches spreads one cell about every 1.5 s, up to 3 cells on a floor and again after any drop, so a source within that reach of the body reaches it before another decision; a lava source turns to obsidian the instant water touches it from a side or above; pouring lava back into a pool source changes nothing. Good: a concrete casting step that keeps the uncast lava's flow off the body or lands it where water already touches the landing cell (placing the cooling water first, building or checking a walled mould, or returning the lava to the pool). Bad: pouring lava so its uncast flow reaches the player's own cells, pouring water into the supply pool, mining obsidian with an iron pickaxe, waiting or finishing. Neutral: reads, inspections of the target cells, plan or intent updates. Judge only from the facts in the wake.
